question: Which Indian actress was named National Ambassador for Cyber Safety by Ministry of Home Affairs in October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashmika Mandanna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **October 2024**, the **Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)** appointed popular Indian actress **Rashmika Mandanna** as the **National Ambassador for Cyber Safety**.
 
• The appointment was facilitated through the **Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C)**, which is the specialized wing of the **MHA** tasked with handling cyber-related offenses.
 
• The primary objective of this collaboration is to strengthen the fight against **cybercrime** by raising awareness about **online safety**, **digital hygiene**, and the dangers of **deepfake technology**.
 
• As the **National Ambassador**, she will lead various nationwide campaigns to educate citizens on how to protect their **digital identity** and navigate the **internet** securely.
 
• The initiative specifically focuses on reaching the youth and vulnerable sections of society who are increasingly targeted by **cyber fraudsters** and **malicious AI-generated content**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C):**
 
 
• Established in **2018** by the **Ministry of Home Affairs**, **I4C** provides a framework and ecosystem for **Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs)** to deal with cybercrimes in a coordinated manner.
 
• It operates the **National Cybercrime Reporting Portal** (**www.cybercrime.gov.in**), which allows victims to report **financial frauds** and **crimes against women and children** online.
 
• The centre also manages the **National Cybercrime Helpline Number 1930**, which provides immediate assistance to victims of **cyber financial fraud**.
 
 
 
• **Context of the Appointment:**
 
 
• **Rashmika Mandanna** became a vocal advocate for **cyber legislation** after she was targeted by a viral **deepfake video** in late **2023**.
 
• Her personal experience with **identity theft** and **AI misuse** makes her a relatable figure for the **CyberSafe India** campaign, emphasizing the importance of **legal protection** and **strict reporting**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) Role:**
 
 
• Under the leadership of Union Home Minister **Shri Amit Shah**, the **MHA** has prioritized **cybersecurity** as a critical component of **national security**.
 
• The ministry runs the **'Cyber Dost'** handles on various social media platforms to provide **real-time tips** and **advisories** on avoiding **phishing**, **vishing**, and **ransomware attacks**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Cybersecurity Statistics:** According to data from **I4C**, India witnesses a high volume of **cybercrime** complaints daily, with a significant portion being **financial scams** and **social media-related harassment**.
 
• **Deepfake Technology:** This refers to **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** tools used to create realistic but **fake audio or video** clips. The **Government of India** has issued several **advisories** to social media intermediaries under the **IT Rules, 2021**, to curb the spread of such content.
 
• **Digital Hygiene:** This involves practices such as using **Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)**, setting **strong passwords**, avoiding suspicious **links**, and keeping software **updated** to prevent **hacking**.
 
• **National Importance:** By appointing a **National Ambassador**, the government aims to create a **Jan Andolan** (People's Movement) for a **Cyber-Secure India**, ensuring that the **digital economy** remains robust and safe for all users.
